facts.text: SQL Server compatibility level must be 130 or higher; query sys.databases or run ALTER DATABASE command to set it correctly.
Change tracking must be enabled on database; run ALTER DATABASE command to enable with 3-day retention and auto-cleanup.
Cloud migration requires users to have Business Central license and SUPER permission set to run setup and migration tasks.
Integration Runtime must be version 5 if machine has .NET Framework Runtime 4.7.2; otherwise use version 4.
When reusing Integration Runtime for multiple migrations, enter its name in Data Migration Setup instead of leaving field blank.
Cannot migrate multiple on-premises databases to same online environment or same database to multiple environments simultaneously.
Check applicationVersion field in $ndo$tenantdatabaseproperty table; if blank or outdated, migration cannot run.
After migration completes, run Repair Companion Table Records action on Cloud Migration Management page if data is missing.
